title: Real World Evidence Strategy Lead
description:
Job title: Real World Evidence Strategy Lead


  • Location: Morristown, NJ, Cambridge, MA

About the Job


As the Real-World Evidence (RWE) Strategy Lead, you will establish and execute RWE strategies across global Therapeutic Areas, translating medical needs into evidence that drives regulatory, access and medical decisions. Working in close partnership across Medical, Market Access, Health Economics Value and Access, and other cross-functional Brand teams, you lead through influence to deliver innovative, scientifically rigorous real-world studies that generate critical insights and measurable business impact

The Real-World Evidence (RWE) team in OneMedical Pharmacovigilance and Patient Safety (PSPV) serves as an end-to-end strategy and execution partner to solve business problems using real-world data. We partner with cross functional partners to lead end-to-end planning and execution of RWE strategies.


Operating across both our General Medicines (GenMed) and Specialty Care Global Business Units, our RWE team sits at the intersection of data science, medical strategy, and scientific leadership, translating complex real-world data into meaningful insights that drive patient outcomes. We are on an ambitious journey to build a best-in-class RWE capability, harnessing innovative methodologies, cutting-edge real-world data sources, and AI-powered analytics to stay at the forefront of evidence generation.

Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main responsibilities:


The RWE Strategy Lead is a strategic position responsible for establishing the RWE strategy for the relevant global franchise with dedicated assets / brands for agreed indications and other lifecycle strategies in development. He/she is accountable for the end-to-end execution of real- world studies.


This role works in close partnership with Global Medical Leads, Global Market Access and HEVA Leads and other cross-functional partner across the Global Brand Teams to co-create and ensure strategic alignment of the evidence strategy while orchestrates internal and external expertise and resources to deliver flawless execution of studies.


This is a critical role to translate and realize the brand and medical strategy into a fit-for-purpose evidence strategy that delivers scientific value and business impact.


  • Build the asset / brand RWE strategy in alignment with the global disease area strategy; translate medical needs into evidence requirements that is fit for intended purposes for clinical, or regulatory decision-making.
  • Accountable for supporting GenMed medical gaps within the Global Integrated Evidence Generation Plans (IEGP).
  • Partner with Global Medical Lead(s) to ensure robust integrated evidence generation plans (IEGP) that are built with timely and relevant contributions from internal and external global and local experts; and that IEGPs are communicated and documented consistently across strategic plans, brand plans and medical plans.
  • Develop data strategy that enables the realization of the evidence strategy; determine data availability, access and suitability from internal and external sources, in collaboration with the Real-World Data Strategic Partnership Lead as needed.
  • Build an understanding of TA lead and follow on indications with real-world data to deliver insights that support scientific and business decision-making and launch readiness. Conduct initial data landscaping, assessment and preparation for RWE strategies in future new indications and/or formulations as the asset / brand strategy develops and the TA strategy evolves.
  • Serve as methodological expert in the design and execution of real-world study plans to address critical evidence generation gaps as well as in-house study methodology expert leveraging opportunities across the Sanofi ecosystem (AI, platforms, digital, etc.), internal teams and external service providers using innovative RWE study designs and analytics to deliver on critical needs.
  • Deliver strong pre- and peri-launch support to prioritized countries for asset / brand to inform clinical guidelines and drive medical adoption.
  • Develop defensible budgets for real-world studies in collaboration with relevant internal and external stakeholders, including RWE Operations, Sanofi Global Hub and/or vendors as appropriate, to support the annual strategic and budget planning process and periodic updates (final accountability for budget remains with Medical franchise Head).
  • Manage the end-to-end execution of real-world studies ensuring deliverables are on time, within budget, to specification and of high scientific rigor that demonstrates commitment to quality.
  • Work seamlessly with partners and stakeholders to influence in the matrix organization and identify solutions in an optimal and efficient manner; synergize and optimize resources and efforts where appropriate.
  • Maintain timely communication and close alignment with team members, partners and stakeholders to ensure clear and timely visibility the evidence strategy, study Progress and anticipation of challenges and risk mitigation.
  • Represent Sanofi’s RWE capabililities externally e.g. scientific congresses, discussions with regulatory bodies, etc.
  • Contribute to building /transforming the RWE culture/capability at enterprise level

About You


You are a self-starter who brings your energy, expertise and experience as well as takes an entrepreneurial approach to solving problems, have a growth mindset and are passionate about unleashing the power of real-world data with data science to improve health.


  • Advanced degree in pharmaco-epidemiology, biostatistics, Health Outcomes, or equivalent discipline. PhD is preferred.
  • Formal education in business or management is desirable.
  • At least 10 years real-world evidence generation in or for the pharmaceutical industry.
  • End-to-end leadership of RWE studies from concept to study completion and publication for regulatory or reimbursement submissions.
  • Use of innovative RWE methodologies to address evidence gaps.
  • Significant peer reviewed publication track record in epidemiology, clinical, statistical and/or HEOR journals required.
  • Experience working in multiple therapeutic areas – experience in Immunology, Rare Diseases, Oncology, Neurology, Ophthalmology is highly valued.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and alignment in complex global matrix teams.

Soft skills:

  • Strategic and visionary thinking to shape, influence and articulate innovative evidence generation.
  • Systemic thinking and focus on impact.
  • Strong sense of urgency, ownership and proactive attitude to deliver value to our brands.
  • Ability to influence, engage and motivate teams as well as senior leaders through personal advocacy, vision and drive.
  • Ability to adapt and communicate messages to a wide range of audiences at all levels (both scientific and commercial), inside and outside of the organization, to convince others of the value of our brands.
  • Ability to effectively negotiate and compromise with internal and external stakeholders to achieve optimal results for the business, agile to change, and obtain and manage budgets.
  • Apply growth mindset to develop new skills or knowledge.

Technical skills:

  • Demonstrated expertise in pharmacoepidemiology, HEOR and RWE study designs and methodologies, including innovative techniques.
  • Experience working with routinely collected data (claims databases, electronic medical health records, registries and various structured and possibly unstructured sources in the healthcare sector within pharmaceutical company settings.
  • Ability to build an evidence strategy from business needs and translate into study requirements.
  • End-to-end project management of real-world studies and management reporting.
  • Good working knowledge of the commercial strategy (i.e. market share, competitors, product positioning) and ability to adapt evidence strategy in anticipation of market changes.

Languages:

  • Fluency in spoken and written business English mandatory.
  • Proficiency or working knowledge of French or other European languages a plus.

Why Choose Us


  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.

title: Batch Release Lead
description:
About the Role


The Batch Release Lead is responsible for providing Quality Assurance oversight for final drug substance disposition, batch release, deviation management, change control and Product Quality Review activities.


The role works closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory and other site stakeholders to ensure products are appropriately assessed and dispositioned in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), site quality requirements and applicable regulatory standards.


The incumbent will also support quality investigations, audits and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen site quality systems and operational effectiveness.


Key Responsibilities

Batch Disposition & Release

  • Perform final drug substance disposition for release to secondary customers.
  • Review batch-related quality information and ensure all requirements are satisfactorily completed prior to disposition.
  • Investigate and resolve issues or deviations impacting batch release.
  • Ensure all batch release and disposition activities are performed in compliance with GMP and applicable quality requirements.
  • Participate in Quality Alert/Product Alert meetings, ensuring investigations and associated actions provide sufficient information to support lot disposition decisions.

Deviation & Investigation Management

  • Act as the QA reviewer for site deviations, ensuring investigations are comprehensive, scientifically sound and completed in a timely manner.
  • Lead and/or support root cause analysis investigations for quality incidents and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive measures are identified.
  • Review investigation outcomes and assess potential impact to product quality and batch disposition.
  • Serve as the operational Quality point of contact for complaint investigations requiring site support, including coordination of investigation reports.

Quality Systems & Compliance

  • Review, assess and approve site change controls, ensuring potential quality and regulatory impacts are appropriately evaluated.
  • Perform Product Quality Reviews (PQR) in accordance with site and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Regulatory Support Officer to ensure compliance with applicable local and international regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure activities are performed in accordance with GMP, site procedures and established Quality Assurance principles.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen deviation investigation processes, Progress monitoring and overall effectiveness.
  • Review performance metrics and trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support improvements to Quality systems and operational processes while maintaining regulatory compliance.

Audits & Inspections

  • Participate in internal and external audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Support inspection readiness activities and provide Quality documentation and subject matter support as required.
  • Support follow-up and closure of observations and associated actions where applicable.

Skills & Experience

Experience

  • At least 5 years of Quality Assurance experience within the pharmaceutical industry, with a strong focus on deviation management and batch release/disposition processes.
  • Strong knowledge and practical understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Quality Assurance principles.
  • Experience supporting quality investigations, change controls and other pharmaceutical Quality systems.

Skills

  • Strong capability to investigate, assess and resolve quality issues or deviations efficiently.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with root cause analysis.
  • Ability to analyse performance metrics and trends and identify areas for improvement.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and activities simultaneously.
  • Effective cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous, dynamic and fast-changing environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to quality, compliance and timely execution.

We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees. With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology, and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. Sanofi's portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine.

At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life and health. The Area Business Manager (ABM) is responsible for engaging Dermatologists and other key customers within an assigned geography and presenting clinically focused selling messages to create and grow revenue and to consistently deliver product goals related to Atopic Dermatitis, Prurigo Nodularis, CSU and BP.


The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals. This will be accomplished by driving performance and delivering results in a compliant manner with a high degree of integrity strictly following all Sanofi US policies and in compliance with all policies and procedures governing the promotion of pharmaceutical/biological products in the US.


We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Engage Dermatology/Immunology customers within assigned geographical territory and deliver clinically focused message to introduce, launch, grow brand-share and revenue and to consistently deliver on product goals for atopic dermatitis and other dermatological indications.

  • Plan, organize, and execute local promotional speaker programs and activities.
  • Maximize budget allocated to the geographic territory to support execution of strategies and tactics and generate/grow the business.
  • Participate and help lead initiatives to support sales success as assigned (e.g. participate in industry related congresses, local and regional meetings and medical conferences).
  • Own business opportunities within respective geographic area, which includes coordination and calling upon large group practices and other key targets to drive overall product results.
  • Establish relationship with thought leaders in assigned territory. Primary objective is to drive industry leading customer value.


About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university.
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical and scientific product-related information.
  • Ability to travel to meetings/trainings/programs as necessary - additional travel may be required within the assigned territory.
  • Proven success and positive track record of consistent sales performance in complex markets with diverse customer segments operating with a high degree of integrity within compliance guidelines.
  • Ability to operate as a “team player” in cooperation with collaboration partners and internal colleagues to reach common goals.
  • Valid Driver’s License.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years selling sub-cutaneous self-injectable (or office administered IV) biologics in a complex and competitive market.
  • 2+ years selling experience in dermatologic disorders such as atopic dermatitis strongly preferred.
  • 2+ years selling experience calling on Dermatologists.
  • Launch experience in specialty care and biologics strongly preferred.
  • Alliance/matrix partnership experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrate advanced clinically based selling skills.
  • Results oriented with a proven track record of success with product launches.
  • Experience with in-servicing and training office staff, nurses and office managers.

title: Global Therapeutic Area Head, Respiratory
description:
Job title: Global Therapeutic Area Head, Respiratory

  • Location: Cambridge, MA

About the Job

You will be working at the heart of the Global Alliance Immunology Franchise where we take pride in our commitment to excellence and value our team culture. What drives us is the opportunity to make an impact with Immunology products that truly can transform the lives of people living with COPD, Severe Asthma, Atopic Dermatitis, Chronic Rhinosinusitis with Nasal Polyposis, Prurigo Nodularis, Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria, Bullous Pemphigoid, Eosinophilic Esophagitis and Allergic Fungal Rhinosinusitis.


As Global Therapeutic Area Head, Respiratory, you will report to the Global Head of Alliance Immunology and own the end-to-end global strategy for our multi-indication Respiratory portfolio across Severe Asthma and COPD. You will lead a high-performing, multi-disciplinary franchise team, as well as specialists across International Markets, Customer Engagement, Patient Marketing, and Market Development, serving as the internal champion and external face of the Respiratory franchise.


This role is an opportunity to transform the practice of medicine in Respiratory and cement Sanofi's position as an undisputed global leader in immunology.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities

Global Strategy & Execution Excellence

  • Develop and own the global brand strategy, positioning, and go-to-market plan for the Respiratory portfolio across Asthma and COPD, ensuring full alignment with Sanofi's vision, alliance commitments, and market opportunities
  • Co-create bold short-, mid-, and long-term strategic ambitions together with key markets, alliance partners, and external stakeholders, translating deep insights into a compelling and differentiated value proposition
  • Facilitate regular strategy reviews, alignment forums, and knowledge-sharing sessions with local markets to drive global-to-local coherence and accelerate in-market performance
  • Develop global campaigns, best practice playbooks, and modular content that empower local markets to execute with excellence and speed
  • Develop targeted, market-relevant initiatives to address and dismantle barriers to biologic uptake in COPD, ensuring Sanofi is positioned as the category-defining leader in this space
  • Drive a differentiation strategy across both Asthma and COPD that ensures a compelling, distinct, and leading value proposition

Irresistible Team & Culture Ambition

  • Attract, develop, and retain world-class talent and lead a high-performing cross-functional team
  • Act as a member of the Global Immunology Alliance Leadership Team, demonstrating enterprise leadership through best practice sharing, mentoring, and active contribution to franchise-level initiatives
  • Create and articulate an inspiring vision for the organization that engages teams across functions, geographies, and levels — and brings them along on the journey

Commercial Leadership & P&L

  • Own full P&L accountability for the global Respiratory franchise, leading strategic and financial planning to maximize portfolio value across both indications
  • Own, develop, and regularly update the global revenue forecast across markets, ensuring projections are grounded in rigorous analysis and aligned with strategic priorities
  • Own and manage the global commercial operating budget, ensuring ROI-driven investment allocation and disciplined resource management
  • Develop and track KPIs to measure the impact of global and local/regional commercial activities, holding the franchise accountable to ambitious performance standards

Pipeline & Life Cycle Management

  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Medical Affairs, Clinical Program Management, and alliance partners to develop a life cycle strategy aligned with the Respiratory franchise vision and long-term leadership ambition
  • Represent the global commercial perspective in Life Cycle Management governance and R&D clinical development programs, ensuring commercial viability and patient relevance are embedded in development decisions
  • Lead commercial strategy development, conduct commercial assessments, and support the development of robust business cases for pipeline and life cycle opportunities
  • Serve as a key voice in Alliance governance and EXCOM-level discussions, representing the franchise's commercial interests with clarity, credibility, and strategic conviction

About You

Experience

  • 15+ years of Progressive experience in biopharmaceutical commercialization, with a track record of delivering exceptional results in complex, matrixed, global environments
  • Demonstrated Marketing leadership experience at Global and Local level (preferably with US commercial experience), including ability to build marketing strategies, experience in launch, brand planning, omnichannel and Forecast/ Budget/ Resource allocation
  • Mastery of cross functional collaboration with R&D, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Public Affairs with a proven biologics launch experience and demonstrated ability to collaboratively drive market shaping activities and evidence generation
  • External stakeholder engagement: fluent in advancing Customers & Patient engagement, at a Country and Global level
  • Experience in Respiratory would be a strong differentiator
  • Alliance management experience and exposure to executive committee (EXCOM) governance is a significant advantage
  • Demonstrated experience in leading and inspiring teams as well as in attracting, developing and retaining top talents
  • Strong P&L management experience, including global revenue forecasting, budget ownership, and ROI-driven investment decision-making

Leadership skills

  • Strategic thinking: ability to disrupt status quo with innovation while remaining pragmatic and focused on priorities. When under pressure, ability to bring others along to explain how strategic ideas fit into the larger context, and approach challenges thoroughly with a broad view, considering different potential outcomes. Be organizationally astute and know how to manage politics with integrity.
  • Growth Accelerator: A high level of comfort taking calculated risks, pushing limits, and stimulating new opportunities — both for the franchise and for the broader enterprise. Driven to transform the industry, not just compete within it.
  • People Leadership: ability to lead through influence, inspire teams, engage and leverage everyone’s strengths while being highly self-aware. Set high standards and expectations, communicates proactively, collaborative and approachable and ability to provide meaningful feedback, coaching and support.
  • Relationships and Influence: Culturally savvy and adaptable, with the ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural environments. Effective stakeholder management, politically astute and role models teamwork and collaboration
  • Result orientation: driven to develop and execute optimal strategy meeting corporate objectives, while creating pragmatic solutions. Comfortable with ambiguity and ability to adapt with agility, take calculated risks and anticipate potential issues.

Education

  • MBA or other advanced degree strongly preferred

title: System Engineer – Windows (Deployment and Support)
description:
• Location: Barcelona, Spain

About the Job


As System Engineer – Windows within our Digital Technology – Service Quality team, you'll be the backbone of Sanofi's enterprise Windows infrastructure — powering the platforms that thousands of employees, manufacturing sites, and life-saving applications depend on every day. If you believe infrastructure should be built from code, owned end-to-end, and engineered to never fail, this role was made for you.

We sit at the heart of Sanofi's digital transformation. Our Windows engineering team owns the platform that most of our enterprise and manufacturing applications run on — and the identity services everything else depends on. We combine modern cloud platforms, automation-first engineering, and relentless service excellence to support Sanofi's mission: chasing the miracles of science.

About Sanofi


Sanofi is dedicated to supporting people through their health challenges. We are a global biopharmaceutical company focused on human health, committed to chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions

At Sanofi, we believe our people are our greatest strength, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive innovation. Our values — Aim Higher, Act for Patients, Be Bold, and Lead Together — guide everything we do

Main responsibilities


  • Deploy infrastructure as code using Terraform, ARM, or Bicep — provisioning servers that are born compliant, not remediated afterwards
  • Automate post-provisioning configuration with PowerShell DSC, Ansible, or Puppet — from domain join to hardening baselines
  • Own the full server lifecycle — provision, patch, harden, upgrade, and decommission across on-premises data centers, manufacturing sites, Azure IaaS, and AWS EC2
  • Manage Active Directory and hybrid identity — domain controllers, Group Policy, Entra ID, and federation services
  • Drive patch compliance and vulnerability remediation across the Windows estate using MECM/SCCM or Azure Update Manager
  • Provide L2/L3 operational support, participate in on-call rotations, and lead technical recovery during Major Incidents
  • Build observability and AIOps capabilities — dashboards, alerting, and self-healing automation using Datadog and Splunk
  • Represent Windows platform changes at CAB, ensuring every change is traceable, tested, and low risk

About You


  • Experience: Substantial hands-on experience with enterprise Windows Server in large-scale, global environments; regulated industry background (pharma/life sciences) is a plus
  • Technical skills: Windows Server engineering, Active Directory, Failover Clustering, IIS, PKI; cloud IaaS on Azure and AWS; PowerShell at an advanced level; Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred); ServiceNow ITSM and CMDB
  • Soft skills: Strong ownership mindset, calm under pressure, automation-first instinct, and a genuine dislike of doing the same task twice by hand
  • Certifications: AZ-800/801, AZ-104, ITIL 4, Terraform Associate, or equivalent — valued but not mandatory
  • Languages: English required; additional languages are a plus

Why choose us?


  • Global scale — your infrastructure supports patients and employees across the world
  • Automation-first culture — we engineer solutions, we don't click through wizards
  • Hybrid cloud frontier — work across on-prem, Azure, AWS, and Arc-managed hybrid estates
  • Mission-critical ownership — what you deploy, you own — all the way to production stability

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.


Join Sanofi and step into a new era of science - where your growth can be just as transformative as the work we do. We invest in you to reach further, think faster, and do what’s never-been-done-before. You’ll help push boundaries, challenge convention, and build smarter solutions that reach the communities we serve. Ready to chase the miracles of science and improve people’s lives? Let’s Pursue Progress and Discover Extraordinary – together.

title: Associate Director - QSP Quantitative Systems Pharmacology
description:
Job title: Associate Director - QSP Quantitative Systems Pharmacology

Location: Morristown, NJ


About the job:


At Sanofi, a global health care and pharmaceutical company, modeling and simulation approaches support strategy and critical decision making throughout the various phases of drug development. The Disease Modeling (DM) group at Sanofi is seeking to hire a highly talented Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) modeling scientist to support its R&D portfolio. The DM group is part of Quantitative Pharmacology department within the Translational Medicine Unit in the R&D organization of Sanofi.


We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) Modeler to develop and apply mechanistic, multiscale models that inform drug discovery and development decisions across the R&D pipeline. The successful candidate will independently lead QSP modeling efforts, integrate diverse biological and clinical data, and translate model insights into actionable recommendations for project teams. This role partners closely with research, quantitative pharmacology, and clinical stakeholders to enable model-informed decision making. The position is based in Morristown, NJ.


Position Objectives:

  • Design, build, and apply QSP modeling approaches to support decision making within neurology therapeutic area.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Main responsibilities:

  • Interface with project team in aligning M&S needs and develop QSP strategy to address needs.
  • Develop, and implement innovative mechanistic modeling strategies to support project team M&S needs.
  • Communicate modeling predictions to key stakeholders to inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Identify and interpret preclinical and clinical data critical for model development and refinement.
  • Stay current with advances in systems pharmacology, disease modeling, and regulatory expectations for model-informed drug development
  • Contribute to abstracts and manuscripts.
  • Perform job duties independently with minimal supervision and mentor others to develop similar capabilities.

About you:


Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering, Applied mathematics, Systems Biology/Pharmacology or related fields.
  • ≥6 years of hands-on QSP modeling experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with demonstrated impact on R&D programs.
  • Track record of productivity, with evidence of independence in leading scientific projects. Strong publication record in QSP modeling commensurate with experience.
  • Hands-on experience with programming languages like Matlab/R/Julia (Matlab preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience using QSP models to directly influence go/no‑go decisions, and competitive differentiation within pharma setting.
  • Deep understanding of disease biology within at least one therapeutic area and experience applying QSP across multiple programs or drug modalities.
  • experience working with heterogeneous datasets, including preclinical, and clinical data.
  • Experience with best practices for reproducible, well‑documented modeling workflows.
  • Proven ability to lead modeling workstreams and clearly communicate quantitative insights to scientific and non‑scientific stakeholders, tailoring complexity to the audience.
  • Experience mentoring junior scientists.

Knowledge And Skills Desirable but Not Essential:

  • Understanding of neurology, neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration
  • Exposure to regulatory interactions or documentation involving modeling and simulation.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

description:

  • Requirements analysis and engineering

  • Experience in working with third parties and offshore development teams

Thought Leaders:

You are seen as an expert in your field and will be the ‘go to’ person for your area of specialism within Munich Re. You will be seen as a role model/mentor to others – identifying opportunities to share your knowledge with others.

title: Digital Business Analysis Lead Omnichannel
description:
Job title: Digital Business Analysis Lead Omnichannel

  • Location: Japan

---


Summary of the role


Reporting directly to the Digital Head, the Digital Omnichannel Local Digital Representative is a technology-driven digital leader who serves as the strategic architect and execution leader for Sanofi Japan's Omnichannel ecosystem. S(he) is accountable for defining the multi-year Omnichannel vision aligned with global digital strategy, assessing capability gaps across GBUs/Franchises, and driving adoption to world-class levels — eliminating unjustified disparities between business units.


Omnichannel leadership is at the core of this role — driving the end-to-end orchestration of digital touchpoints across email, web, mobile, social, and consent management to deliver seamless customer engagement in the Japan market.


What sets this role apart is not the ability to implement — that responsibility belongs to the Global Product team — but something arguably more valuable: the depth of hands-on development and implementation experience to understand exactly how things are built, why they work, and what it takes to make them work better in the Japanese market. This individual possesses the skills to implement, but deliberately chooses to focus their energy on maximizing the business value of solutions in the market. They engage with Global Product teams not as a passive recipient of technology, but as a credible, technically grounded partner who can challenge, negotiate, and co-create with authority.


You'll partner with GTMC's Omnichannel team — responsible for commercial capability building, content operations, and customer engagement execution — to align digital product strategy with business activation needs. This is a strategic role combining deep technical acumen with business leadership, shaping the future of customer engagement at Sanofi Japan.


As AI continues to compress the distance between product lines and end users, the defining value of this role lies in the ability to lead business transformation through technology understanding — not just alongside it.


---


Key Responsibilities


For the Digital Omnichannel products under her/his scope:


Strategic Planning & Vision


• Define Sanofi Japan's Omnichannel strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with global digital direction

• Establish success metrics and target state vision for each GBU/Franchise, and continuously update strategic goals based on market evolution and global product releases

• Conduct capability gap analysis across business units and develop closure plans to elevate adoption levels — eliminating unjustified disparities between GBUs/Franchises


Global Community Leadership & Innovation


• Active participation and leadership in the Global Omnichannel Community

• Bring global best practices to the Japan market and share Japan's learnings and practices back to the global community

• Influence Global Product teams' roadmap and strategy with market insights and requirements

• Navigate the dynamic shift from traditional Omnichannel to AI-powered next-generation customer engagement

• Co-create the future of customer relationships with BUs and GTMC in an evolving landscape where AI is fundamentally reshaping solutions

• Balance respect for proven approaches with bold exploration of emerging possibilities


Cross-Functional Partnership


• Partner with GTMC's Omnichannel team — responsible for commercial capability building, content operations, and customer engagement execution — to align digital product strategy with business activation needs

• Collaborate with GBU/Franchise Marketing teams to translate business needs into digital requirements

• Act as the primary liaison between local business stakeholders and Global Digital Omnichannel Product teams; serve as key POC for business customers at country level, acting as primary gatekeeper for new requirements


Product Portfolio Ownership


• Be end-to-end accountable for digital products under his/her scope within Omnichannel in Japan

• Drive implementation, localization, and adoption of global digital products across all GBUs/Franchises; contribute actively to Product delivery teams providing market-specific business acumen and support Product Managers (and Product Owners) through implementation/activation locally

• Ensure that Digital Products/computerized systems meet all controls to address applicable data privacy, audit, and cybersecurity requirements at local level

• Manage content digital marketing platforms (DAM; Promomats) and provide insights to business and GTMC teams regarding new content foundation

• Contribute to boosting consent management (Akamai) and optimise use of CPC for customer consent and profile management

• Ensure websites optimization program and global positioning guidance compliance

• Collaborate with Global Omnichannel Product teams to release global-to-local strategies, roadmaps, and deployment plans; monitor the evolution of digital technologies — including AI-driven search, generative tools, and emerging martech — and proactively assess their relevance and applicability to the Japan market


Technical Leadership & Advocacy


• Develop business value proposals using a deep understanding of business processes and technology to help business stakeholders achieve their desired outcomes — translating local business requirements into precise technical specifications that Global teams can act on, and vice versa

• Work with Digital and Business stakeholders to elicit requirements and capture business needs (digital demand management); understand the customer journey, and define user requirements feeding into global product features backlog (innovation loopback)

• Engage with Digital and Business stakeholders and influence project decisions; assess the risks of various solutions and prioritize competing business demands — leveraging hands-on development and implementation experience to accurately understand concrete steps and processes, enabling constructive and efficient collaboration with Global teams

• Be the expert of local business acumen, processes, technical requirements, and local tech stack; identify gaps between global product capabilities and local market requirements and propose technically sound, feasible solutions

• Design and oversee measurement frameworks — defining what to measure, why, and how — across web, social, and marketing automation channels; lead troubleshooting at the root-cause level, designing resolution approaches rather than applying surface-level fixes

• Support and advise the business on how to maximise value and utilisation of global digital products to support their business strategies

• Negotiate feature requests, customizations, and implementation timelines with Global Product stakeholders in English, backed by technical rationale

• Engage with Digital Omnichannel community members acting as local representative of this stream

• Provide strategic partnering for Digital Marketing channels and technologies including email management tools (SFMC), websites (Magnolia), mobile apps, chatbots, etc.


Capability Building


• Coach business customers to make use of technology and data, driving adoption of global digital products; champion digital capability building across the GTMC team, elevating the team's collective digital maturity


---


Organizational Context


Reports to

Digital Head, Sanofi Japan

Matrix collaboration with

Global Digital Omnichannel Community

Scope of Accountability

Technology-led strategic accountability for Omnichannel vision, roadmap, and adoption across all GBUs/Franchises in Japan, in partnership with GTMC and business stakeholders

Key Partnerships

GTMC (commercial capability/content operations), GBU/Franchise Marketing, Global Digital Product Teams, Compliance/Legal/IT Security


---


Why This Role Matters


This is not a support or coordination role — it is a strategic leadership position with direct impact on Sanofi Japan's digital transformation.


You will:

• Shape the multi-year Omnichannel vision for one of Sanofi's key markets

• Drive measurable business impact through digital adoption and optimization across all GBUs/Franchises

• Influence global product strategy with your market insights and technical credibility

• Build a legacy of digital excellence — closing capability gaps and elevating the organization to world-class Omnichannel maturity

• Work directly with the Digital Head as a strategic partner and trusted technical advisor


This role is ideal for someone who wants to combine deep technical expertise with strategic business leadership — and who thrives on seeing their work translate into real-world business and patient outcomes.

• ✅ Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms and customer engagement platforms in a technical capacity — demonstrating platform-agnostic adaptability rather than single-tool dependency

• ✅ Digital agency or consultancy background with multi-client, multi-solution technical delivery experience — evidence of platform-agnostic technical capability

• ✅ Experience in technical requirements definition and negotiation with global product teams, in an English-language working environment

• ✅ Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., pharmaceutical, financial services, healthcare IT, or telecommunications) where digital implementation requires strict compliance with regulatory frameworks (data privacy, audit trails, change management, approval workflows) is strongly preferred. > **Critical Note:** This role does **not** involve hands-on development or implementation — that is the responsibility of the Global Product team. However, candidates *must* have prior development and implementation experience. This background is essential for accurately understanding the concrete steps and processes involved, and for enabling productive, technically credible collaboration with Global teams. The ideal candidate *can* build — and precisely because they can, they know how to partner effectively with those who do.


Language Requirements

Candidates who are not comfortable conducting technical conversations in English will face significant limitations in this role.

---


Career Progression & Development


This role offers meaningful pathways for career advancement within Sanofi's global digital organization.


• Near-term (1–2 years): Establish yourself as a trusted digital strategist for the Japan market; build deep expertise in Sanofi's Omnichannel ecosystem; demonstrate measurable impact on adoption and business outcomes across GBUs/Franchises.


• Mid-term (2–4 years): Expand your impact by taking on broader digital leadership responsibilities within Japan; build a track record that opens doors to other positions within Sanofi's global digital organization.


• Long-term (4+ years): Apply for digital leadership roles in other Sanofi markets or within Global Digital teams. Sanofi actively encourages and supports internal mobility — your hiring manager is committed to advocating for your next career opportunity.

Are you ready to build Sanofi's Transplant business in Poland from the ground up? You will lead the launch of Rezurock and establish the foundations for a commercial team in a strategic priority area. This is your opportunity to shape market strategy, drive launch excellence, and make a meaningful impact on patients' lives in a rare and complex therapeutic area.


Career Opportunity

This role is ideally suited for a senior commercial or marketing professional who has built a strong track record in specialty care and is ready to take the next step in their leadership journey. We are looking for an accomplished marketer with an entrepreneurial mindset who is eager to expand beyond brand leadership into people management, team building, and broader business ownership.

As Launch Lead Poland – Transplant, you will have the opportunity to shape market strategy, drive launch excellence, and influence key business decisions in a highly visible area of the organization. This position offers a unique pathway to develop the capabilities and experience required for future Progression into broader commercial leadership roles, including potential Business Unit Head opportunities within Sanofi.


About Sanofi

We are a global biopharmaceutical company driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.


Main Responsibilities


Launch Leadership & Commercial Execution

  • Lead launch readiness and execution for Rezurock and future transplant products in Poland, delivering against sales targets and top-line growth within budget
  • Represent the Polish market in Global Launch Readiness Reviews
  • Track key performance indicators and objectives, identifying opportunities for business efficiency and simplification

Customer Engagement & Market Shaping

  • Drive direct customer-facing activities across the transplant portfolio, engaging healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, and patient communities
  • Execute personal and non-personal promotional campaigns, advisory boards, and peer-to-peer initiatives
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with key opinion leaders, payers, and cross-functional partners to support market access and commercial success

Omnichannel Strategy & Marketing Excellence

  • Adapt and implement omnichannel engagement strategies for the Polish market
  • Translate global frameworks into locally relevant, patient-centric narratives and digital-first go-to-market approaches
  • Lead projects through legal, regulatory, and medical review processes
  • Manage marketing budget and ensure compliance with all relevant guidelines

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, customer-centric commercial team
  • Foster a culture of ethics, inclusion, accountability, and entrepreneurial thinking
  • Develop talent and drive team engagement aligned with Sanofi's values

About You

Experience

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, with strong ambition to take on formal people leadership (previous line management experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite)
  • Digital and omnichannel experience with a customer-facing, go-to-market mindset
  • Experience in brand planning and leading cross-functional initiatives with a strong focus on patient-centric outcomes
  • Pharmaceutical industry experience with a track record in specialty care, rare disease, oncology, transplant, or other innovative therapeutic areas; product launch experience preferred
  • Strong background in strategic marketing, brand leadership, and commercial excellence

Skills & Competencies

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to challenge the status quo and drive business efficiency
  • Strong leadership and people development capabilities
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels
  • Ability to lead complex programs with agility, simplicity, and pace
  • Self-driven, resilient, and results-oriented with a strong sense of accountability

Education & Languages

  • Master's degree preferred
  • Full professional proficiency in English and Polish

Why Choose Us?

  • Patient Impact: Make a direct impact on patients in a rare and complex therapeutic area where unmet need is high and every launch decision matters
  • Strategic Ownership: Own the commercial strategy for the Polish transplant market from the ground up, with the autonomy and entrepreneurial freedom to shape how care is delivered
  • Leadership Development: Build and lead your own commercial team, developing talent and driving a culture of accountability, inclusion, and high performance
  • Innovation & Growth: Be part of a simpler, digital- and AI-powered business with multiple new therapies planned through 2030 and beyond
  • Meaningful Work: Turn bold ideas into breakthrough launches that bring innovative transplant therapy to patients in Poland who need it

Źródło pozyskania Danych Osobowych

Możemy pozyskiwać Twoje Dane Osobowe z następujących źródeł:

a. bezpośrednio od Ciebie (np. gdy sam przesyłasz nam swoją aplikację, odpowiadasz na naszą ofertę pracy, wypełniasz nasz formularz rekrutacyjny, przychodzisz na spotkanie rekrutacyjne);

b. z baz danych prowadzonych przez agencje (firmy rekrutacyjne), w których zarejestrowałeś się jako osoba poszukująca pracy, pod warunkiem, że udzieliłeś zgodę na udostepnienie nam przez taką agencję Twoich Danych Osobowych w celach rekrutacyjnych,

c. od twoich poprzednich pracodawców, jeżeli dobrowolnie zgodzisz się na to abyśmy poprosili ich o przekazanie nam opinii jak oceniali Cię jako pracownika (tzw. referencji),

d. z portali internetowych, w których zamieszczasz publicznie informacje o swoim doświadczeniu zawodowym, wykształceniu, zainteresowaniach, dotychczasowej ścieżce kariery itp. (np. linkedIn).

Cel przetwarzania Danych Osobowych

Będziemy przetwarzać Twoje Dane Osobowe na potrzeby przeprowadzenia rekrutacji w ramach, której aplikujesz na określone stanowisko pracy. Jeżeli się zgodzisz będziemy przetwarzać Twoje dane także w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych, jeżeli nie zostałeś wybrany do zatrudnienia na stanowisku, na które pierwotnie aplikowałeś. Za Twoją zgodą udostępnimy Twoje Dane Osobowe do innych spółek z Grupy Sanofi, aby one także mogły przedstawiać Ci swoje oferty pracy i zapraszać do udziału w rekrutacjach.

Podstawa prawna przetwarzania danych

Przetwarzamy Twoje Dane Osobowe zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem UE 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych), zwanym dalej „RODO” działając na podstawie:

a. przepisów prawa pracy, w szczególności Kodeksu pracy, które wskazują jakie dane pracodawca powinien uzyskać od kandydata do pracy (podstawa prawna: art. 6 ust. 1 lit. c i art. 9 ust. 2 lit. b RODO),

b. Twojej zgody na przetwarzanie danych (podstawa prawna: art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a i art. 9 ust. 2 lit a RODO), w przypadku gdy:

· dobrowolnie przekazujesz nam więcej Danych Osobowych niż wymagają przepisy prawa pracy,

· udzielasz agencji (firmie) rekrutacyjnej, w której bazie się zarejestrowałeś, na udostepnienie nam Twoich Danych Osobowych w celu uwzględnienia twojej aplikacji w ramach prowadzonej przez nas rekrutacji,

· udzielasz nam zgodę na przetwarzanie Twoich Danych Osobowych w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych,

· zgadzasz się abyśmy udostępnili Twoje Dane Osobowe innym spółkom Grupy Sanofi w ich własnych celach rekrutacyjnych.

Udzielenie powyższych zgód jest dobrowolne i mogą one zostać wycofane w dowolnym momencie. Zwróć jednak uwagę, że skorzystanie prawa do wycofania udzielonej wcześniej zgody nie będzie miało wpływu na legalność naszych działań, które były prowadzone w oparciu o Twoją zgodę jeszcze zanim została ona wycofana.

c. realizacji naszych prawnie uzasadnionych interesów polegających na umożliwieniu nam w przyszłości obrony przed ewentualnymi roszczeniami z zakresu równego traktowania i dyskryminacji w zatrudnieniu (podstawa prawna: art. 6 ust. 1 lit. f i art. 9 ust. 2 lit. f RODO).

Odbiorcy danych

Dostęp do Danych Osobowych mogą mieć następujący odbiorcy danych:

· upoważnieni pracownicy Administratora oraz usługodawcy (mogą to być spółki z Grupy Sanofi lub zewnętrzni dostawcy), jeżeli dostęp do danych jest niezbędny takiemu usługodawcy dla realizacji usług świadczonych dla Administratora. W szczególności należą do nich podmioty takie jak agencje (firmy) rekrutacyjne, które szukają dla nas najlepszych kandydatów do pracy lub wspierają nas w takich poszukiwaniach. Jeżeli otrzymaliśmy Twoje dane osobowe od agencji rekrutacyjnej, to w takim przypadku możemy udostępnić tej agencji informacje dotyczące Twojego zatrudnienia w zakresie niezbędnym do rozliczenia wynagrodzenia agencji za pomyślny wynik rekrutacji, jeżeli zostaniesz zatrudniony. Ponadto dostęp do Twoich danych mogą mieć również podmioty dostarczające nam narzędzia i systemy IT wykorzystywane do przetwarzania danych w procesach rekrutacyjnych, w tym dostawcy portali internetowych dla osób poszukujących pracy. Zawsze jednak dostęp do Danych Osobowych mają tylko podmioty, w przypadku których istnieje uzasadnienie takiego dostępu z uwagi na wykonywane zadania i świadczone usługi. Dbamy o to aby nasi pracownicy przechodzili odpowiednie szkolenia z zakresu ochrony danych osobowych poprzez zapoznawanie ich z wewnętrznymi politykami i procedurami ochrony danych lub dedykowane programy szkoleniowe. Wszystkie osoby upoważnione do przetwarzania Danych Osobowych są zobowiązane do zachowania poufności danych i ich zabezpieczenia przed ujawnieniem osobom nieuprawnionym.

· podmioty z Grupy Sanofi, którym Dane Osobowe są udostępniane do wykorzystania we własnych procesach rekrutacyjnych, jeżeli udzieliłeś nam zgodę na takie udostepnienie danych.

Transfer danych do państw trzecich (państw spoza EOG)

Dane Osobowe mogą trafić do odbiorców w dowolnym z krajów, w których Grupa Sanofi prowadzi swoją działalność. Niektórzy z odbiorców danych mogą znajdować się w krajach spoza Europejskiego Obszaru Gospodarczego (EOG), które nie zapewniają takiego samego poziomu ochrony danych osobowych jak kraje należące do EOG. Na taką okoliczność Administrator stosuje odpowiednie mechanizmy mające na celu ochronę Danych Osobowych, w tym w szczególności Wiążące Reguły Korporacyjne Grupy Sanofi albo umowę o przekazaniu danych opartą na standardowych klauzulach umownych przyjętych przez Komisję Europejską. W celu uzyskania dalszych informacji na temat krajów, do których przekazywane są dane lub stosowanych mechanizmów przekazywania danych można skontaktować się z Administratorem na wskazane poniżej dane kontaktowe.

Okres przechowywania danych

Dane Osobowe będą przechowywane przez okres rekrutacji, a w przypadku niewybranych kandydatów także przez 3 miesiące od jej zakończenia wyłącznie w celu ich wykorzystania w razie potrzeby w rekrutacji na to samo stanowisko np. w przypadku gdy pierwotnie wybrany kandydat zrezygnował z oferty pracy. Po ostatecznym zakończeniu danej rekrutacji możemy jednak zachować Twoje Dane Osobowe na potrzeby obrony przed ewentualnymi roszczeniami z zakresu równego traktowania i dyskryminacji w zatrudnieniu, jednak nie dłużej niż do czasu upływu okresu przedawnienia tych roszczeń, który wynosi 3 lata (w przypadku wszczęcia postępowania przed sądem okres ten ulega jednak przedłużeniu do czasu zakończenia takiego postepowania). Jeżeli natomiast zgodzisz się na przetwarzanie Twoich Danych Osobowych w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych będziemy je przetwarzać w tych celach nie dłużej niż do momentu, gdy wycofasz swoją zgodę. W przypadku, gdy w wyniku rekrutacji zostaniesz zatrudniony, będziemy przetwarzać Twoje Dane Osobowe w ramach procesów zatrudnienia. Szczegółowa informacja na temat przetwarzania danych osobowych pracowników zostanie Ci przedstawiona na etapie zawierania umowy o pracę.

Zasady gromadzenia danych

Podanie Danych Osobowych jest obowiązkowe w zakresie wskazanym w art. 22¹ § 1 i 4 Kodeksu pracy. Wszelkie dodatkowe informacje podajesz dobrowolnie udzielając zgodę na ich przetwarzanie. Niepodanie danych wymaganych będzie skutkowało odrzuceniem Twojej aplikacji w procesie rekrutacyjnym.

Prawa związane z przetwarzaniem Danych Osobowych

Jako podmiot danych możesz skorzystać wobec Administratora z następujących praw:

a. prawa do żądania dostępu do swoich Danych Osobowych i uzyskania informacji na temat ich przetwarzania, a w przypadku gdyby były nieprawidłowe ma prawo do żądania ich sprostowania (zgodnie z art. 15 i 16 RODO),

b. prawa do żądania ograniczenia przetwarzania Twoich danych w sytuacjach i na zasadach wskazanych w art. 18 RODO (Każdy podmiot danych może żądać ograniczenia przetwarzania jego danych osobowych na okres weryfikacji ich prawidłowości lub do czasu rozpatrzenia jego sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania danych. Prawo to przysługuje także w sytuacji gdy zdaniem podmiotu danych przetwarzanie jego danych jest niezgodnie z prawem, lecz nie chce on aby dane te zostały od razu usunięte lub w przypadku gdy dane są mu potrzebne dłużej niż zakładał przyjęty okres przetwarzania, z uwagi na kwestie ustalenia lub obrony roszczeń),

c. prawa do wycofania udzielonej wcześniej zgody na przetwarzanie Danych Osobowych, co jednak nie będzie miało wpływu na legalność przetwarzania Twoich danych, które odbywało się w oparciu o tę przesłankę i miało miejsce przed skorzystaniem przez Ciebie z prawa do wycofania zgody,

d. prawa do żądania usunięcia danych zgodnie z art. 17 RODO („prawo do bycia zapomnianym”),

e. prawa do przeniesienia Danych Osobowych zgodnie z art. 20 RODO, tj. do otrzymania od Administratora swoich danych osobowych w ustrukturyzowanym, powszechnie używanym formacie nadającym się do odczytu maszynowego (przez komputer), a także do żądania ich przekazania do innego administratora danych; Prawo to dotyczy tylko danych, które sam nam dostarczyłeś, przetwarzanych na podstawie Twojej zgody i mających postać elektroniczną,

f. prawa do sprzeciwu wobec dlaszego przetwarzania danych zgodnie z art. 21 RODO.

Ponadto masz prawo wnieść w skargę na przetwarzanie Twoich Danych Osobowych przez Administratora do Prezesa Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych (adres: ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa).

Dane kontaktowe Administratora oraz jego inspektora ochrony danych

Aby skontaktować się z Administratorem w celu skorzystania z wyżej wskazanych praw dotyczących przetwarzania danych osobowych należy odwiedzić stronę internetową: https://www.sanofi.com/en/data-protection-contact(opens in new window)

W celu skontaktowania się z naszym Inspektorem Ochrony Danych prosimy o przesłanie wiadomości mailowej na adres: iod@sanofi.com(opens in new window)

Administrator może pozostawić w swoich zasobach Dane Osobowe osoby występującej z wnioskiem lub żądaniem w zakresie niezbędnym do udokumentowania, iż ich rozpatrzenie odbyło się zgodnie z przepisami prawa. Dane te będą przetwarzane nie dłużej niż do czasu przedawnienia roszczeń, co stanowi prawnie uzasadniony interes Administratora, o którym mowa w art. 6 ust. 1 lit. f) RODO.

title: Network Platform Automation and Performance Engineer
description:
Job title: Network Platform Automation and Performance Engineer

  • Location: Hyderabad
  • Hybrid Mode

Our Team:


Develop, Deploy and Manage Next Generation (NextGEN) Network technology solutions aligning with Sanofi’s vision and growth are the key functions of Sanofi’s Connectivity team. This team, behind Sanofi’s Next Generation Network & Security services and infrastructure that powers it, is looking for a self-motivated and innovative thinking individual to raise the bar on Sanofi’s Network infrastructure while maintaining relevance in the fast moving and evolving network industry.

As a member of the team, you will be driving optimization, scalability, and maintaining the performance of network infrastructure that supports digital platforms. In this role, you will bridge traditional networking and modern platform/DevOps needs, ensuring our distributed applications, cloud services, and internal systems operate with ultra-low latency, high resilience, and maximum efficiency.

You will also act as the technical subject matter expert for network data paths, traffic management, and performance diagnostics by interacting with cross-functional team engineers, architects, internal and vendor partners to evangelize and provide NextGEN network technology solutions to;

  • Maximize the business value from Sanofi’s Digital Technology and Solutions investments.
  • Unleash innovation for our organization, employees, and customers.

Main responsibilities:


  • Platform Automation Engineering
    • With expertise across routing, switching, WAN, data center, and cloud networking, automation of network provisioning, configuration, validation, compliance, monitoring, and remediation.
    • Design and develop scalable, reusable automation frameworks and services.
    • Automate complex multi-vendor network environments across LAN, WAN, data center, SD-WAN, and cloud.
    • Develop automated workflows for network changes, incident remediation, and lifecycle management.
    • Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual network operations.
    • Develop API-driven workflows and automation services.
    • Establish automation standards, design patterns, coding practices, and reusable modules.
    • Monitor Connectivity platform performance, troubleshoot issues, and automate routine tasks.
    • Maintain CI/CD pipelines, security, and data protection for platform systems.

  • Platform Performance Engineering
    • Develop automated network health and compliance checks.
    • Integrate telemetry, monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms into automation workflows.
    • Build event-driven automation and automated remediation capabilities.
    • Leverage AI/ML and AIOps capabilities to improve network troubleshooting and operational efficiency.
    • Evaluate opportunities for predictive analytics and intelligent network operations.
    • Monitoring and analyzing network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement performance tuning strategies
    • Drive Automation & Continuous improvement of Network platform solutioning, specification & design, systems integration, platform lifecycle management, standards, and documentation.
    • Drive process improvements that integrate automation and monitor effectiveness to improve efficiency & service delivery.
    • Conduct regular audits, performance tests, generate reports, and track KPIs for network health to manage resource allocation within the network to meet platform demand.

About you:

  • Leadership & Behavioral Competencies
    • Technology leadership skills along with strong Interpersonal & Problem-Solving skills.
    • An enthusiasm for staying up to date with the very latest updates with Network technology solutions.
    • Ability to translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
    • Strong software engineering mindset.
    • Ability to influence engineering decisions.
    • Strong written and verbal communication.
    • Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
    • Strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, security, and scalability.

  • Technical Skills

    • 7+ years of experience in network engineering, with substantial experience in network automation.
    • Strong enterprise networking background with expertise in routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN, and network security.
    • Advanced Python programming experience.
    • Strong hands-on experience with Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, Git, JSON, and YAML.
    • Experience developing production-grade automation frameworks.
    • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices.
    • Experience working with multi-vendor network environments.
    • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code and configuration management.
    • Networking in cloud computing experience (Azure, AWS, & GCP)
    • Familiarity and understanding of tunnelling protocols (vxLAN, GRE, IPSec)
    • Working knowledge of DNS, Tacacs, Radius, DHCP, NetFlow, Syslog, etc.
    • Exposure to SCADA modelled Network and concepts.
    • Vendor (technical) management experience
    • Occasional work outside business hours

title: Access Governance and Compliance Expert
description:
Job title: Access Governance and Compliance Expert

  • Location: Hyderabad

About the job

At Sanofi, we are dedicated to transforming healthcare through innovation and
technology. Our digital initiatives focus on enhancing operational efficiency, improving patient outcomes and delivering best in class workplace experiences. We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Workday Security Expert to oversee and manage the security framework of our Workday system.

This role focuses on monitoring, auditing, and ensuring compliance with security policies while collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain a secure Workday environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Workday security principles and compliance standards but will not be directly responsible for system configuration.

Main responsibilities:

  • Access Management and Monitoring: Govern user access management to the Workday system, ensuring adherence to role-based access control (SOX) principles. Conduct regular reviews of user roles, permissions, and access levels to ensure compliance with organizational policies. Collaborate with People and

  • Culture and Digital teams to validate access requests, approvals, and terminations. Compliance and Audit Support: Prepare for internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and reports. Lead and conduct periodic security audits to identify potential risks or violations. Ensure compliance with regulatory standards such as GDPR, SOX.

  • Collaboration and Stakeholder Support: Partner with P&C, Digital, and other business units to address security-related concerns. Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on security requirements.

  • Reporting and Risk Analysis: Generate reports on user access trends, exceptions, and audit findings. Analyze security incidents or anomalies and recommend corrective actions.

  • Training and Documentation: Educate end-users on Workday security policies, best practices, and procedures. Maintain detailed documentation of security processes, audit findings, and compliance activities. User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Coordinate and facilitate UAT to ensure security configurations meet stakeholder expectations and requirements.

About you:

  • Experience: 5+ years of proven experience with Workday Security, 5+ years’ Experience supporting audits or compliance initiatives.

  • Technical Skills: Workday Security Pro certification is required. Familiarity with compliance standards such as GDPR, SOX.

  • Education: Master's degree in business administration, Information Technology, Human Resources, or a related field.

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex situations and recommend effective solutions.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships
    and work effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Languages: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of
    conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Why choose us?

title: Palveluneuvoja keikkatyöhön Pihlajalinnaan Helsingin lääkärikeskuksiin
description:
Hei terveydenhuollon osaaja! Kiinnostaisiko sinua keikkatyö Pihlajalinnan lääkäriasemilla Munkkivuoressa, Kampissa ja Pikku Huopalahdessa tai Itäkeskuksessa? Toivomme, että voisit keikkailla säännöllisesti sekä arkisin että viikonloppuisin ja mielellään useammassa lääkärikeskuksessa.

🦊Työpaikka Pihlajalinnassa

Meille Pihlajalinnassa unelmien työpaikka tarkoittaa paikkaa, jossa ihminen tulee ensin. Asiakaslähtöisessä toiminnassamme huokuu ihmisläheisyys, yksilöllisyyden kunnioittaminen ja arvostava arki. Me pihlajalinnalaiset huolehdimme toisistamme, autamme toisiamme onnistumaan ja luomme ympärillemme iloista, mutkatonta ja turvallista työarkea. Toimintamme nojaa periaatteisiimme: rakennan luottamusta, onnistun yhdessä ja pidän huolta.

Palveluneuvojana työskentelet osana motivoitunutta lääkärikeskuksiemme moniammatillisia tiimejä. Asiakaspalvelussa työhösi kuuluu asiakkaiden ilmoittautumisten vastaanottamista, ajanvarausten ja asiakastietojen hallintaa, laskuttamista ja asiakkaiden ohjausta sekä opastusta palvelupisteellä. Palveluneuvojana olet Pihlajalinnan kasvot ja tuotat laadukasta asiakaspalvelua konsernin arvojen mukaisesti. Yhteistyö eri ammattilaisten ja asiakasryhmien kanssa on aloitteellisuutta vaativaa ja sen tarkoituksena on mahdollistaa lääkärikeskuksen päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuus. Pääsetkin työssäsi mahdollistamaan lääkärikeskuksen päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuutta.

💎Sinä olet meille tärkeä

  • Saat hyvän perehdytyksen ja kannustavan tiimin tuen monipuolisiin tehtäviin lääkärikeskuksessamme

  • Huolehdimme osaamisestasi tarjoamalla kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia, jatkuvasti käytössäsi olevan oppimisympäristö Pihlajalinna Akatemian ja saat esiperehdytyksen jo ennen työsuhteen alkua työyhteisöön tutustumisen tueksi

  • Työnantajana ja kollegoina lupaamme kuunnella ja auttaa sinua kehittymään työssäsi. Palkkauksessa ja työehdoissa noudatamme terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta sekä huomioimme työkokemuksesi ja osaamisesi yksilöllisesti

Olisitko sinä uusi työkaverimme?

Sinulla on

  • terveydenhuollon koulutus (lähihoitaja tai sairaanhoitaja tai muu terveydenhuollon AMK tutkinto) ja Valviran rekisteröinti tai voit olla loppuvaiheen opiskelija tai lääketieteen opiskelija

  • kokemusta vastaavista asiakaspalvelutehtävistä, mielellään yksityisen terveydenhuollon alalta

  • mielellään käyttökokemusta asiakastietojärjestelmistä (esim. Dynamic Health)

  • asiakaspalveluhenkinen työskentelyote ja hyvät organisointitaidot

  • sujuva suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito ja pärjäät työssä myös englannin kielellä

  • sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon asiakas- ja potilastyössä vaadittava tartuntalain mukainen soveltuvuus
