description:
2027 Summer Co-op Opportunities, Cambridge, MA

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you'll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

This co-op opportunity will have a 4-6 month duration starting June 2027.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Available Disciplines

  • Neuroscience Research: Tackle some of humanity's most challenging diseases affecting the brain and nervous system, from Alzheimer's to rare neurological disorders

  • Analytical Development: Pioneer new testing methods that will become industry standards, ensuring the medicines of tomorrow meet the quality patients deserve

  • Process Chemistry: Optimize synthetic routes and develop scalable manufacturing processes for drug substances, applying green chemistry principles to deliver safe, efficient medicines at global scale.

  • Immunology: Measure the body's immune responses to develop vaccines and immunotherapies that could prevent the next pandemic or cure autoimmune diseases

  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Drive positive social and environmental impact by developing and implementing initiatives that align with Sanofi's commitment to improving lives, supporting communities, and advancing sustainable practices across the organization

  • Molecular Biology: Decode the language of life itself, using DNA, RNA, and protein analysis to advance gene therapies and precision medicine

  • Translational Models Research: Develop and investigate disease models that translate scientific discoveries into insights for treating human disease and advancing new therapies

  • Public Affairs & Patient Advocacy: Bridge science, policy, and patient communities by engaging with advocacy organizations, monitoring policy trends, and advancing patient access to innovative treatments.

  • Biostatistics: Apply statistical methods and computational tools to analyze biological and clinical data, supporting evidence-based decisions across drug discovery, development, and commercialization

  • Medicinal Chemistry: Design and create entirely new molecules that could become tomorrow's blockbuster medicines, combining creativity with cutting-edge science

  • Laboratory Automation: Implement robotic systems that accelerate scientific research and make high-throughput analysis possible

  • In-vitro Biology: Conduct experiments that reveal how potential medicines interact with human cells, taking the first crucial steps toward new treatments

  • Machine Learning/AI: Build intelligent systems that could predict which drug candidates will succeed, revolutionizing how medicines are discovered and developed

  • Drug Product Development: Shape the final form of medicines that patients receive, ensuring every pill, injection, or treatment delivers hope and healing with precision and safety

  • Medical Affairs: Serve as the medical and scientific voice for Sanofi's medicines, educating healthcare providers and supporting optimal patient care

Currently enrolled at an accredited college or university pursuing a degree in:

or

or

​

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:

About the job

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

About the Sanofi Digital:

We are an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the centre of our ambitions.

Sanofi’s Digital organization’s mission is to transform Sanofi into a data-first and AI first organization by empowering everyone with good data. Through custom developed AI products built on world class data foundations and platforms, the team builds value and a unique competitive advantage that scales across our markets, R&D and manufacturing sites. The team is located in major hubs in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Cambridge, Bridgewater, Toronto, Budapest and Hyderabad. Join a dynamic, fast paced and talented team, with world class mentorship, using AI to chase the miracle of science.

We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Lead data scientist to drive innovation and impact at the intersection of AI and Commercial Pharma operations. This role will be a part of the Digital Commercial Advanced Analytics and AI team, which operates under the Digital Global Business Units and is an integral part of Sanofi Digital Organization.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions that drive measurable business value across Commercial functions, some examples of use cases are

    • Enhancing the patient journey through intelligent and personalized support

    • Autonomous agents for omnichannel engagement

    • AI & GenAI driven transformation of market access and payer strategies

    • Conversational AI for data interactions and insights (Talk-to-data capabilities)

    • Development of unified platform of sales, marketers and MSL users powered by multi-agent systems

    • Agentic AI powered Market research and competitive intelligence platform

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for complex AI initiatives, providing guidance on solution architecture, model selection, experimentation approaches, and implementation best practices

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI products, from business problem framing and prototype development through deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and continuous improvement

  • Partner closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, and platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

  • Drive adoption of AI solutions by effectively communicating complex technical concepts, model outputs, and business insights to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Contribute to the evolution of Commercial AI, data, and platform strategies through technical expertise, innovation, and industry best practices

  • Ensure AI solutions comply with Responsible AI principles, governance requirements, security standards, and enterprise policies

  • Develop and promote reusable frameworks, coding standards, accelerators, documentation, and best practices to improve delivery quality and efficiency

  • Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI, evaluating emerging technologies and identifying opportunities to create business value

  • Mentor junior Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and interns through technical coaching, code reviews, solution reviews, and knowledge sharing

  • Contribute to innovation initiatives, technical publications, patents, and AI communities of practice

  • Support talent acquisition, workforce planning, and capability-building initiatives to strengthen the organization's AI and Data Science capabilities

About you

Required Qualifications:

  • Master or PhD Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Physics, Computational Linguistic or a related field

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, or related disciplines, with a proven track record of delivering business impact through data-driven solutions, with 1+ years hands-on experience in GenAI or LLM-based applications and familiarity of Agentic AI frameworks

  • Strong programming skills in Python or Java or other enterprise programming languages SQL/NoSQL query, familiarity with Spark, REST APIs, Golang, NodeJS, Angular, Typescript etc.

  • Experience developing AI applications using modern frameworks and libraries such as LangChain, LangGraph & Transformers

  • Strong expertise in machine learning methodologies including predictive modeling, classification, regression, forecasting, recommendation systems, optimization, causal inference, experimentation, and statistical analysis

  • Strong understanding of agentic AI architectures, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and AI application evaluation frameworks

  • Knowledge of NLP tools like regex and fuzzy string matching

  • Proficiency in working with variety of data assets (Structured and un-structured) hosted in different databases like Snowflake, vector databases, and cloud-native AI services

  • Good understanding of agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and orchestration of multi-step AI steps by building AI agents Experience creating and deploying code libraries using functions, classes in Python in AI product-focused development under an agile environment

  • Experience in production-ready model & software development

  • Deep understanding on managing AI/Gen-AI end-to-end life-cycle management

  • Experience working in cloud-based environment such as AWS or GCP or Azure and using cloud-technologies and native ML/GenAI tools for building AI-solutions

  • Experience with various enterprise-level Application Programming Interfaces (APIs)

  • Knowledge of regulatory, compliance and ethical considerations in AI/GenAI

  • Nice to be already involved in an Agile/Scrum environment and Comfortable utilizing tools like Jira & Confluence

Functional Skills:

  • Proven ability to lead complex AI and Data Science initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams

  • Ability to influence technical direction and design decisions through expertise and thought leadership rather than formal authority

  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical and AI solutions.

  • Experience presenting technical concepts and recommendations to both technical and business audiences

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, problem-solving, and collaboration skills

  • Ability to balance innovation, technical excellence, business priorities, and delivery timelines

  • Nice to have experience in life sciences and healthcare and experience in a complex global organization

  • A demonstrated ability to work and collaborate in a team environment, working with multi-cultural global team

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment and to manage multiple priorities

  • Fluent in English (Other languages a plus)

When joining our team, you will experience:

  • An international work environment, in which you can develop your talent and realize ideas and innovations within a competent team

  • An attractive, market-oriented salary and other benefits

  • Flexible home office policy, with a possibility to work up to 40% of time from home / where you can easily schedule your office days

  • An individual and well-structured introduction and training of new employees and we will dedicate a Buddy for you to better navigate in your first weeks

Why Choose Us?

Based in Japan and reporting to the T1D Medical Head, you'll work at the intersection of science, strategy, and patient impact, collaborating with local and global teams to advance a truly pioneering treatment area.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main responsibilities

• Support the development and execution of the Japan Medical Plan for T1D, providing scientific input for medical content and contributing to cross-functional initiatives including regulatory interactions and lifecycle planning.

• Lead and support medical communication activities — including publication planning, congress and symposia participation, and advisory board presentations — to advance scientific exchange with the medical community.

• Build and nurture relationships with key opinion leaders and scientific societies, collecting and sharing medical insights to inform strategy and strengthen Sanofi's presence in the T1D space.

• Plan and execute company-sponsored clinical studies and externally sponsored research collaborations, including post-approval studies and Investigator-Sponsored Studies, to generate meaningful real-world evidence.

• Analyze real-world data in collaboration with internal and external experts to deepen understanding of T1D and support evidence-based decision-making.

• Partner with Medical Science Liaisons and global medical teams to develop field strategies that address the evolving needs of healthcare professionals and patients.

• Ensure all medical activities are conducted with the highest standards of scientific integrity and in full compliance with applicable regulations and guidelines.

About you

• Experience: Background in medical affairs, R&D, or clinical research within the pharmaceutical industry, including experience in an MSL or Medical Advisor/Medical Manager capacity; prior involvement in clinical trial or study management is a strong advantage.

• Technical skills: Strong scientific acumen in a relevant therapeutic area (immunology, endocrinology, or related field); ability to critically analyze and interpret clinical and real-world data; experience in medical writing and publication activities.

• Soft skills: Strategic thinking with the ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across functions; strong interpersonal skills with a genuine commitment to serving healthcare professional needs; approachable, adaptable, and a clear communicator.

• Education: Advanced degree (MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent) in a relevant medical or scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Languages: Fluent in Japanese; business-level English (reading and writing) required.

Why choose us?

• Help shape the future of care for one of the most scientifically exciting areas in immunology — autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes — and contribute to a potential paradigm shift in how the disease is treated and delayed.

• Be part of a bold launch journey, bringing a first-in-class immunotherapy to patients in Japan and making a tangible difference in people's lives.

• Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year, and your work will contribute to that reach.

• Turn bold ideas into breakthrough outcomes, with multiple new therapies planned through 2030 and beyond.

• Stretch your career in a development-rich environment, with opportunities to grow across functions, regions, and the full product lifecycle.

• Collaborate with world-class scientists, medical experts, and cross-functional teams in a purpose-driven culture that values scientific integrity and innovation.

• Enjoy a well-rounded rewards package that supports your success — with comprehensive healthcare, flexible working arrangements, and 14 weeks of gender-neutral parental leave.

---

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.

Join Sanofi and step into a new era of science - where your growth can be just as transformative as the work we do. We invest in you to reach further, think faster, and do what's never-been-done-before. You'll help push boundaries, challenge convention, and build smarter solutions that reach the communities we serve. Ready to chase the miracles of science and improve people's lives? Let's Pursue Progress and Discover Extraordinary – together.

description:

About Sanofi


​We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system –and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.​



About the Job


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.​


The purpose of the Field Medical Associate Director Oncology position is to develop the strategy and tactical plan for engagement with the scientific community and to oversee the effective and efficient operation of the oncology MSL, while ensuring that the MSL personnel engage in substantive scientific exchange. Field Medical Associate Director is responsible for strong team capability development and field based medical organization team.


  • Coordinate traversal partnership with internal stakeholders to develop the most effective and efficient strategic plan to interface with external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).

  • Manage MSL capabilities and expected performance through MSL coaching, training, and development to ensure excellent execution of their role and achieving strategic goals.
  • Support the generation and communication of scientific and medical insights to internal stakeholders, develop/execute strategic and tactical Medical Engagement Plans, and manage MSL resources and budgets.
  • Partner with the Medical Director, medical advisors, and other internal partners to manage high-level regional stakeholder relationships, contribute to medical engagement planning, and oversee the MSL budget.

Main responsibilities:


Lead and Implement MSL Strategy Development

  • Ensures clarity and alignment of the roles and responsibilities of the MSL function across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analyses and uses qualitative and quantitative information to understand the critical tasks and resources, including staff, to achieve the desired objectives
  • Supports resource planning for the MSL field force for pre-launch and life-cycle management of products.
  • Attends cross-functional and transversal meetings as needed to collaborate with internal stakeholders that have an impact on MSL strategy
  • Proactively identifies best-practice and sharing across geographies of MSL activities.
  • Ensures job descriptions evolve for territory MSL roles effectively match country launch plans or Medical/ Policy plans for life-cycle products and global guidance/ policies on MSL roles & responsibilities.
  • Ensures appropriate MSL annual planning, objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are utilized and support MSL managers in monitoring these objectives and KPIs
  • Develop recruiting plan for team and build business case and secure approval for head count changes
  • Support and engage MSL effectiveness measures / gap analyses and aligned training & education curriculum. Identify and communicate synergies within the Sanofi group training resources and programs to maintain and develop a high performing team
  • Ensures alignment of field medical tools and resources to medical strategy. Leads ongoing efficiency initiatives with the implementation of new/optimized systems and tools for MSL activities.
  • Ensures management of field insights and feedback are effectively captured and efficiently shared within Medical Affairs and appropriate business partners.
  • Manage vendor relationships to ensure business objectives timeline adherence and budget adherence are being met.
  • Ensure MSL organization employs a governance towards fulfilling global/regional/local and corporate training requirements and compliance towards applicable internal and external policies and regulations.


Develop, monitor, and execute Region/Country strategic and tactical Medical Engagement Plans

  • Collaborate with Head-Office stakeholders to develop country and territory-level strategic and tactical Medical Engagement Plans.
  • Assess medical launch plans, and region medical strategies.
  • Support MSLs towards the identification, mapping and quarterly review of KOLs to develop and maintain customized engagement plans.
  • Monitor and support MSLs execution of plans with their respective teams and with prioritized KOLs via regular coaching sessions
  • Manage and meet reporting requirements of MSL performance towards set KPIs ensuring excellence in execution of their role towards achieving strategic and tactical goals.

Ensure strong MSL relationships with KOLs, engaging and managing relationships with external stakeholders when applicable

  • Support the identification and prioritization of key territory stakeholders and development of customized engagement plans.
  • Regularly monitor key MSL/KOL relationships via MSL coaching sessions and field visits to ensure quality engagements ensuring aligned scientific information exchange with the KOLs.
  • Review, monitor, and analyze insights from the KOLs on key information concerning the strategy, products, image, or competition to assess KOL needs, priorities, expectations, satisfaction. Engage with select external stakeholders as appropriate.
  • Support, attend, and follow up on scientific congresses, symposia, or other events where appropriate

Communicate scientific and medical information/insights to internal stakeholders to contribute to updates of messages, plans, and strategy

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to provide scientific inputs on relevant materials and coordinate training support where appropriate.
  • Provide/organize scientific and technical support to internal stakeholders to facilitate development of medical strategy.
  • Aggregate and communicate KOLs insights on key scientific medical and clinical experience and share with stakeholders.
  • Facilitate and encourage exchange of Medical leadership and best practices via communication and organized meetings and events among MSLs and with other functions, both locally and across geographies and GBUs.


Dimensions/Scope

  • Manage of MSLs, including complete oversight of the near-term needs (e.g. training, coaching, performance evaluations, recognition, disciplinary actions if needed) and long-term requirements (e.g. career plan, etc.)
  • Set, track, and monitor agreed KPIs as well as develop and execute course correction, as necessary.
  • Steer and guide team reporting and planning / KOL reviews monthly / quarterly and annually (where appropriate) in accordance with Medical Affairs strategy.
  • Regular review, Monitor, and analyze data/insights from the field as it relates to feedback from the KOLs on key information concerning our company’s strategy, products, image, or competition.


About you


Required qualifications:


Education

  • Degree from an accredited university (MSc, PhD, Pharm D, MD) required.
  • Specialization in hematological diseases preferred.
  • Post-bachelor’s degree from accredited university (e.g. MBA or equivalent): valuable, not required

Experience

  • Total years of experience – 5+ Years
  • Total years of experience in oncology – 3+ Years
  • Prior experience as an MSL or other field or head-office medical role required.
  • People management experience required, preferably in a field medical role.

Specifics skills

  • Strategic Thinking: The capacity to anticipate trends, set long-term priorities, and align medical affairs activities with broader organizational and therapeutic area goals.
  • People Leadership & Coaching: The ability to inspire, develop, and empower team members through mentorship, feedback, and creating an environment where individuals can grow and perform at their best.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Building and maintaining productive relationships with key internal and external stakeholders — including KOLs, payers, and regulators — to advance shared objectives.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working effectively across departments (e.g., commercial, regulatory, clinical) to align strategies, share knowledge, and deliver integrated solutions.
